visual.general_description: Close photograph of an infant chest and abdomen with diffuse faint pink-red skin discoloration.
visual.detailed_description: One unlettered color photograph of the bare chest and abdomen of an infant, shot from above with the head out of frame. The skin shows diffuse, blotchy pink to red discoloration across the trunk, more intense over the right side of the picture and near the axilla. Both nipples are visible, an arm is visible along the upper edge, and the infant lies on a fabric with a multicolored floral pattern; a white cloth edge is visible at the left. No printed text, labels, scale bars, dates or device text are visible and no face is visible.

visual.detailed_description: One unlettered color photograph of a forearm and hand lying on green surgical drapes. The hand lies at the right with the fingers partly flexed. No printed text, labels, scale bars, dates or device text are visible and no face is visible.

visual.general_description: Photograph of an upper limb after suture of a long fasciotomy wound with dark discolored skin areas.
visual.detailed_description: One unlettered color photograph of a raised upper limb with a long wound running from the wrist region up the forearm and elbow, closed by many black interrupted sutures. Along the suture line there are areas of dark red to black discoloration and yellowish tissue at several points, and larger black patches of the skin to the left of the suture line. Medical equipment (a monitor-like device with a knob, tubing and cables) and patterned bedding are in the background, and a hand is visible at the top. No legible printed text, labels, scale bars, dates or face are visible.
